description:
The 'Eco-Friendly Sneaker' product has messy data: its 'Color' attribute was entered manually as text ('Green') instead of using the global store taxonomy. This breaks the sidebar filters.

Your task is to fix this:
1. Edit the 'Eco-Friendly Sneaker'.
2. In the Attributes tab, REMOVE the custom text-based 'Color' attribute.
3. ADD the global 'Color' attribute and select the term 'Green'.
4. Ensure the new attribute is visible on the product page.
5. Do NOT remove or modify the 'Material' attribute (it should remain as custom text).
6. Save the product.

Use the WooCommerce admin panel at http://localhost/wp-admin/ (already logged in).
